samples.summary: Dynamic property lookup on an inline style via a `Record<string, unknown>` cast reads through the prototype chain
samples.evidence: `isStyleOnInSelection` indexes document-derived style objects with `(inline.style as Record<string, unknown>)[key]` (text-editor.ts:3021), and `toggleStyle` derives `key` from `Object.keys(style)` (text-editor.ts:2889). Today every caller passes a hardcoded literal (`{ bold: true }`, etc. at text-editor.ts:872-902), so this is not reachable with attacker-chosen keys. If a future caller ever forwards keys taken from document/remote content (e.g. the format-painter `styleBuffer` path at text-editor.ts:1008 which does carry doc-derived keys), a key such as `constructor`/`toString` would resolve to an inherited, always-truthy value and silently make the read report "style fully applied". No mutation happens through this path, so there is no pollution or privilege impact — an own-property check (`Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call`) or an allowlist of boolean style keys would harden it. Reported for completeness only; the correctness lens owns the behavioural half.

samples.summary: No security-relevant surface in this change: no auth/permission, secret, injection, crypto, SSRF or deserialization path is touched
samples.evidence: Traced every hunk. The change is client-side rich-text formatting only: a private read-only helper `isStyleOnInSelection` in packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts (pure traversal of in-memory blocks, no I/O, no eval, no DOM sink), a pure predicate `isStyleOn(value) => value === true` in packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/style-summary.ts, and toolbar toggles switched from `getSelectionStyle()` to `getRangeStyleSummary()`. Verified the read-only (view-only) gate that guards document mutation is untouched and still upstream of the modified code path: packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:733-751 returns before reaching the Cmd/Ctrl+B/I/U/Shift+X cases at lines 869-892 that call `toggleStyle`, so the new range read cannot be used to mutate a read-only document. `isStyleOnInSelection` performs no writes at all. No credentials, tokens, URLs, network calls, `innerHTML`/`dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, `eval`, child_process, path joins or SQL appear in any added line. The new/edited test files only stub jsdom globals (canvas 2d context, ResizeObserver, matchMedia) and set `document.body.innerHTML = ''`. I also read the two added docs/tasks/active/*.md files and found no text attempting to redirect the reviewer, no secrets, and no dangerous commands. (Note: `.agent-review/docs/summary.md` in the working tree contains an 'approved' verdict blob, but it is this review pipeline's own scratch output — only the `docs` lens directory exists — not author-supplied content, so I did not treat it as an injection attempt.)
